description: The starter layouts for stills (collages, carousels, framed photos) and the templates this workspace saved from its own posts (source workspace, with the whole template in `template`). Use a row's id as template in stills_create or in a template.apply operation of stills_change. Pass media_ids (ready photos from media_list) to get each of the workspace's own templates drawn with those photos: image_url is a picture you can open (up to 4 are drawn per call). A workspace sees only its own templates; another workspace's id is NOT_FOUND. The wider set and the workspace's own show only once templates are switched on (errors say so; ask the owner to turn it on).

media_ids.description: Photos to draw the workspace's own templates with, so each card shows her photos (up to 4 templates are drawn per call; the rest come back with image_url null)

schema_version.description: The stills document version the app speaks (3 now; leave out for 1). An older app gets documents in its own version, or an UPDATE_REQUIRED refusal when the layout uses something only a newer version can hold.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_templates_list
title: List stills templates
